title: Approval-gated public AWS career sandbox
event: A locally deployed private career sandbox used administrator-backed CDK bootstrap and could not enforce public-repository environment reviewers.
pattern: Cloud learning evidence alternated between synth-only artifacts and locally credentialed deployment, neither proving a protected CI identity path.
structure: GitHub environment approval delays token issuance; an exact OIDC subject limits identity; a constrained CloudFormation execution policy limits capacity; the public repository makes reviewer enforcement available.
archetype: Shifting the Burden: local administrator credentials accelerate one deploy while weakening the durable approval and audit system.
intervention: Make the public repository canonical, reuse or create account OIDC in a one-time human ceremony, constrain CDKToolkit, issue deployment identity only after environment approval, and deny all running/product infrastructure.
leading_indicators: Tests prove exact trust, manual-only workflow, deploy-job-only OIDC, pinned actions, serialized changes, audit artifacts, and zero synthesized runtime capacity.
transfer: For consequential automation, place approval in the identity issuance path and enforce the workload boundary again in the downstream execution policy.
